what: a half ring between two arcs (both radial lines on the axis) revolved a full turn from a sketch plane 10 mm above the origin (volume +34 %)
method: the revolve is a hollow ball of radii 40 and 18.5 centred at (0,0,10): V = 4/3 pi (40^3 - 18.5^3), A = 4 pi (40^2 + 18.5^2); two spherical faces, one body with an inner shell.
